title: Immunisation
description: Show the body a harmless trace of an invader and it is ready for the real one. Unlocks an Anomaly Ward for each of the Anomaly's infections.

puzzle.goal: A disease spreads at R0. Write the share H that must be held safe so each case makes less than one more (herd immunity).
puzzle.name: Threshold
puzzle.method: Each case meets R0 others; if a share H is immune it makes R0(1 - H). Below one when H > 1 - 1/R0.
